fusion_alpha.note: SP circularity: fold alpha selects 0.0 only because P_market is derived from the same SP. Do not change the default until >=50 races carry genuine pre-race odds.

legacy_v576.description: v5.76 production baseline. Market anchor gamma=1.3, pre-Phase-2 factors (no form shrinkage, no rating blend, plain draw normalisation) and the dead weight/gear/pace factors zeroed then renormalised. Kept for historical comparison only.

current_v586.description: Deployed v5.86 production profile. gamma=1.0, alpha=0.2 (0.35 at extreme prices), T=8, calibration identity, all nine factors live with Phase-2 form shrinkage / rating blend / field-size draw.

honest_v586.description: v5.86 model constants evaluated without leakage: jockey/trainer win rates recomputed as of each race date, every factor-weight table fitted on the training folds only, and odds labelled pre-race vs SP. The only future comparison baseline.

evaluation.roi_label: SP upper bound; ROI on genuinely pre-race prices only

exp_segmented_gamma.description: Phase 1 flag (off by default, no A/B scheduled): fit a separate market exponent per odds band, walk-forward, train-only. Commit B found most folds pick 1.0 and OOS NLL is no better than gamma=1.0, so this stays a frozen diagnostic only.

exp_platt.description: Phase 1 flag (off by default, no A/B scheduled): rolling Platt scaling fitted on the previous 150-300 races only. Commit B measured <0.01 NLL improvement, so the deployed identity calibration stays.

exp_avail_aware.description: Phase 2 shadow flag (off by default): drop the weights of factors whose inputs are missing and renormalise. Isolated honest re-test on the pre-Phase-2 baseline: +0.0028 NLL (CI -0.0021..+0.0093, 3/5 folds), so NOT validated; kept for forward shadow measurement only.

exp_availability_gate.description: Phase 1 shadow flag (off by default): when valid win-odds coverage for the race is below 80%, set the market weight to 0 so P_final = P_model. Historical data is ~100% SP coverage, so the rule has no historical variance; shadow records accumulate on future races with missing odds or genuine pre-race snapshots.

exp_draw_v2.description: Phase 2 shadow flag (off by default): draw score v2 is already deployed via factors.draw_k and features.draw_field_size, so enabling this flag is an identity check that the live formula still matches the validated one; the shadow column should equal live.

exp_timing_fusion.description: Phase 1 flag (off by default): market weight depends on odds availability and time to post - 0 when odds are missing or coverage < 80%, 0.55 when more than two hours out, 0.80 inside two hours. Cannot be backtested until >=50 races carry genuine pre-race odds timestamps.

exp_extreme_favourite_guard.description: Phase 1 flag (off by default): soft cap on model weight for favourites priced below 1.6. Only three OOS races fall in the band, so it stays off until the sample grows.

exp_dual_probability.description: Phase 1 flag (off by default): emit a main probability (bet sizing) and a value probability (mispricing detection) side by side.

exp_st1000_draw_reversal.description: Phase 2 flag (off by default): allow the 1000m Sha Tin draw coefficient to invert. Only 5 OOS races at the trip, so the default coefficient stays 0 extra bias.

exp_speed_engine.description: Phase 2 display-only flag (off by default): best_time stratified speed rating shown in the UI, never entering P_model. The Phase-2 ablation measured +0.011 to +0.032 NLL when blended in.

exp_finish_time_margin.description: Phase 2b display-only flag (off by default): finish_time and margin features. Recent meetings carry 0% coverage for both, so they cannot be scored yet.
